All attacks will do 2 damage at max to him!|Beginning of Wave 35 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Templar''' was a high health [[Enemies|enemy]] which appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode exclusive [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode. It wields a minigun which is used to fire at towers randomly, which stuns them for a short period of time. It has [[defense]], meaning that most forms of damage against the '''Templar''' is decreased. It also has 2,000 [[Shield Health]]. ==Appearance== The '''Templar''' appears to be a futuristic warrior, with shiny metal armor and a laser minigun which glows neon red. It wears black and light grey armor and has green skin. It also wears black gloves. It wears a helmet with horns, with its eyes covered with a red strobe of light. It is slightly larger than the average enemy. The '''Templar''' has a death animation, where it will drop its laser minigun and slowly fall backwards. ==Strategy== *Like all other tanky enemies, high DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]] or [[Minigunner]] should be used to take the '''Templar''' down. **The [[Commander]] should be used to boost the firerate of these towers. **The [[Engineer]] is recommended, as its sentries will continue firing even when the [[Engineer]] is stunned by the '''Templar's''' ''Minigun'' ability. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] cannot be stunned by the '''Templar's''' ''Minigun'' ability. **The [[Military Base]]'s [[units]] deal full collision damage to the '''Templar''', regardless of its defense, making them quite useful. ***Do note that their ranged damage is still decreased. *It is recommended to place your towers away from the path to avoid getting stunned by the '''Templar's''' ''Minigun'' ability. *It may be viable to have a cheap distraction tower, like a Level 0 [[Commander]], to distract the '''Templar's''' ''Minigun'' from your main offensive towers. *When the '''Templar''' spawns, it will not use its ''Minigun'' ability for a few seconds. Use this period of time to defeat the '''Templar''' before it can stun any towers. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse towers of the '''Templar's''' stun with its ''Revive'' ability. **Do note that this will be ineffective while the '''Templar''' is still firing its ''Minigun'', as the towers will be continuously stunned until the ability is over. *The [[Gladiator]]'s stun blocking is ineffective against the '''Templar''', as the first stun will be blocked, but not any subsequent stuns from the ''Minigun's'' continuous stream of bullets. *Slowing towers like the [[Cryomancer]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]] or [[Freezer]] can be used to slow down the '''Templar'''. **However, because of its large size, freezing towers and the [[Warden]] will slow it down for a shorter amount of time. **Additionally, stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it because of its [[Stun Immunity]]. **Do note that the '''Templar''' will not stop using its ''Minigun'' ability when frozen or stunned. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Jester]] or [[Freezer]] can help to reduce the '''Templar's''' defense. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! TemplarThumbnailClean.png|'''Templar''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyTemplarIconIG.png|'''Templar''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Templar''' is likely named after the [[wp:Knights Templar|Knights Templar]], a Catholic medieval chivalric order, most infamously known for the Crusades. **The '''Templar's''' original helmet is similar to the Great Helm, a helmet that was common in the Christendom of the [[wp:High Middle Ages|Middle Ages]]. *The '''Templar''' was loosely based on the [[w:c:riskofrain2:Clay Templar|Clay Templar]] from ''Risk Of Rain 2''. *The original '''Templar''' can be seen as a chess piece in the [[Chess Board]] map, parodying the Rook chess piece. *Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''Templar''' was one of the few enemies to gain a [[Shield]]. This [[Shield]] reduced the damage dealt by most towers to 2. *The minigun it wields is a modified version of the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/168143042/Galactic-Laser-Gun Galactic Laser Gun] gear from the Roblox catalog. *While in-game the enemy has light green skin, in promotional renders it has red skin and its arms were covered in grey armor instead of being exposed.
